sourceAssertions: The production executor and concrete engine expose StreamTurnAsync and no InvokeTurnAsync or direct ILlmInvocationPort execution path.
Application owns immutable event variants, coalescing, bounds, lease checks, retention policy, and post-commit signal semantics.
Persistence owns operation-row sequence locking, normalized mapping, paging, terminal cleanup, transfer schema v5, and migration.
Event rows contain no prompt, credential, raw frame, raw body, or raw provider error field; unknown failure text is redacted to a stable product code.
The in-process signal is keyed by runtime identity and operation and is registered only as a post-commit accelerator.
No Web/SSE project reference, production partial class, stub marker, or dependency cycle was introduced.
behavioralCases: eight PostgreSQL contexts append unique monotonic sequences to one operation
committed event wakes after commit while rolled-back event produces no wake
a fresh DbContext replays all committed events without first-instance memory
small deltas coalesce, preserve emoji rune boundaries, and flush during provider pause
successful stream finalizes one canonical assistant message with model and usage
partial failed stream persists incomplete replay evidence and compensates the active turn
retention deletes only expired terminal journals and preserves active journals

acceptance.criterion: Every operation event has a unique monotonic sequence within its operation.
acceptance.evidence: Eight concurrent PostgreSQL contexts append under the operation row lock and replay one unique contiguous sequence protected by the composite primary key.

acceptance.criterion: State-transition events commit in the same transaction as their state.
acceptance.evidence: Admission, lease, evidence, transcript, and terminal paths nest in EfLlmChatUnitOfWork; rollback removes the event and suppresses its post-commit wake.

acceptance.criterion: Text chunks are coalesced and bounded rather than one row per token.
acceptance.evidence: Direct tests prove size/natural/time flush, emoji-safe UTF-8 splitting, and configured aggregate/event limits.

acceptance.criterion: Partial output is replayable but never canonical unless finalization succeeds.
acceptance.evidence: The failed-stream pipeline test retains partial text plus incomplete failed state; operation compensation leaves no assistant transcript message.

acceptance.criterion: A second instance reads all committed events without first-instance memory.
acceptance.evidence: The PostgreSQL test appends/commits in one DbContext and replays from a new DbContext; the signal is not used for authoritative reads.

acceptance.criterion: Event payloads contain no system prompt, user prompt, credential, or raw provider error.
acceptance.evidence: Normalized row/source inspection shows no such fields, and the redaction test maps raw secret-bearing failure text to llm-chat.storage-corrupted.
